1. Balloon numbers refer to the PARTS LIST below. Arrangement and exploded views 1:2; Section A-A, View B and the
film 1:1. Stand plan is on GA-001. All figures read from src/*.scad at draw time.
2. Stand and torch both stand on the table: the torch tail is on the table inside the stand bore, 24 mm of barrel
shows above the column, then the head widens. The column centres the torch; it does not carry it.
3. Connector drops over the torch head; the 20 mm seat takes the head and the head's shoulder carries the
4. Film threads straight through: in at one mouth, out the other, in a 35.4 × 1.5 channel. It rides on 3.5 mm
ledges under the sprocket margins and 4 mm lips stop it lifting, so the picture never touches plastic. Snap out
the 0.8 mm post across each mouth before threading. Film plane is 173 above the table.
5. Lens drops onto the three tabs and the breech ring twists to lock. Register 40 film to flange face (Canon FD
nominal 42.0), deliberately short - see GA-001 note 2.
6. Torch and lens are bought parts drawn indicatively from the maker's listing and a generic 50 mm outline;
grooves, knurling, rings and ribs are typical, not measured. Film is nominal (ISO 1007).
